harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured and verified the three-node OpenTelemetry routing topology. Node1 accepts OTLP/HTTP HTTPS with client-certificate authentication, routes payments exclusively to node2 and inventory exclusively to node3, and returns HTTP 503 for missing or unsupported namespaces. All services and retained traces survived verified node restarts.
actions_performed: Installed checksum-verified otelcol-contrib 0.162.0 on all nodes.
Generated a private CA and role-specific mTLS certificates on managed nodes.
Created client credentials under /root/otel-client on node1 with a mode-0600 private key.
Configured node2 and node3 with mTLS OTLP receivers and append-mode JSON file exporters.
Configured node1 with move-only namespace routing and synchronous rejection of unmatched traces.
Verified valid routing, rejection, client-certificate enforcement, no cross-routing, and exactly-once delivery of proof traces.
Restarted nodes individually, corrected the initially observed exporter truncation by enabling append mode, and repeated node2's restart verification successfully.

evidence.requirement: HTTPS OTLP/HTTP gateway, valid routing, invalid namespace rejection, and client mTLS
evidence.summary: After all restarts, payments and inventory returned HTTP 200, unsupported and missing namespaces returned HTTP 503, unauthenticated TLS returned certificate-required, and node1 remained healthy on port 4318.
Node1's gateway certificate successfully verified node2 and node3, while both backend receivers rejected connections without a client certificate.

evidence.requirement: Payments retained only on node2 without duplicate delivery
evidence.summary: payments.json is healthy and contains each selected pre-restart, post-restart, and final payment proof exactly once; inventory, unsupported, and missing counts are zero.

evidence.requirement: Inventory retained only on node3 without duplicate delivery
evidence.summary: inventory.json is healthy and contains each selected pre-restart, post-restart, and final inventory proof exactly once; payments, unsupported, and missing counts are zero.
The CA, client certificate, and client key exist under /root/otel-client; the key is mode 0600 and remained present after restart.
Healthy baseline and boot e8afb731... were captured, reboot acknowledged, boot changed to 736a8200..., and the gateway, credentials, routing, rejection, and listener recovered.
Corrected append-mode baseline and boot 16ece806... were captured, reboot acknowledged, boot changed to 48ffe152..., the pre-restart record survived, and a new record appended exactly once.
Healthy baseline and boot dfeb3b70... were captured, reboot acknowledged, boot changed to 8bc71908..., the existing inventory data survived, and a new record appended exactly once.
